newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Van Miert to brief Commission on BA, Boeing deals.
newsitem.headline: Van Miert to brief Commission on BA, Boeing deals.

text.p: European Competition Commissioner Karel Van Miert was expected to brief his colleagues on Wednesday on the proposed alliances between British Airways and AMR's American Airlines and Boeing and McDonnell Douglas.
A Commission spokesman said this would probably happen during the Commission's weekly meeting. He said he would have no comment on the briefing.
The two deals are the most important and sensitive ones the Commission is currently probing.

Van Miert's briefing comes before he sends Boeing and McDonnell a "statement of objections" detailing the Commission's competition concerns over their planned merger after a three-month investigation.

The Commission is also expected to make a public statement before the end of the week on the BA-American deal after Van Miert informed the British authorities and the companies on Tuesday of its reservations on the transatlantic airline alliance.

Van Miert has the power to adopt such statements without consulting the full Commission, but prefers to inform his colleagues given the high-profile companies involved. -- Brussels newsroom 322 2876841
